_source: Collection copy adapted from myfavoritesweetshoppe.com collection descriptions. Product membership is curated: duplicates, fundraiser copies and expired one-offs removed.

collections.title: Gourmet Caramel Apples
collections.seoDescription: Hand-dipped gourmet caramel apples made in Carnegie, PA, just outside Pittsburgh. Granny Smith apples, homemade caramel, from $7.00. Local pickup or shipping.
collections.intro: Crisp, tart Granny Smith apples, hand-dipped in our rich, buttery homemade caramel, then generously coated with chocolate, nuts or candy.
collections.body: One batch of our caramel takes about three hours and dips roughly 60 to 70 apples. Pick one up on Main Street, ship a box across the country, or join the Club and let us choose for you.

image.alt: A row of gourmet caramel apples with ribbon-tied sticks

collections.title: Hand-Dipped Chocolates
collections.seoDescription: Chocolate pretzel twists and rods, dipped Oreos, stuffed twists, buckeyes, cashew caramel patties and our best-selling Mountain Magic Bites. Made by hand in Carnegie, PA.
collections.intro: Hand-dipped by our family for yours. Pretzel twists and rods, dipped Oreos, stuffed twists, buckeyes and boxes by the pound.
collections.body: Store favorites: the stuffed pretzel twists and Mountain Magic. Singles start at $2, so build a box your way.

image.alt: Hand-dipped chocolate-covered Oreos with chocolate drizzle

collections.title: Chocolate Covered Strawberries
collections.seoDescription: Fresh strawberries hand-dipped to order in milk or dark chocolate. Half-pound and one-pound boxes from $19.95, for local pickup in Carnegie, PA.
collections.intro: Dipped fresh to order in milk or dark chocolate, then drizzled. Half-pound and one-pound boxes.
collections.body: Strawberries are made to order for local pickup or delivery only. We don't ship them. Add your preferred pickup date in the cart notes.

image.alt: Dark chocolate covered strawberries with drizzle

collections.title: Care Packages & Gift Baskets
collections.seoTitle: Chocolate Care Packages & Gift Baskets, Shipped
collections.seoDescription: Curated gift boxes of hand-dipped chocolates and a gourmet caramel apple, shipping included. Send a care package from Carnegie, PA.
collections.intro: All-in-one gift boxes of our hand-dipped chocolates and gourmet treats, beautifully packaged. Shipping is included.
collections.body: Choose your occasion, add a gift message in the cart, and we'll tuck it inside the box. You can note a delivery timeframe too.

image.alt: Happy Birthday care package with chocolates and a caramel apple

seasons.title: Caramel apple season
seasons.headline: It's caramel apple season.
seasons.intro: Fresh Granny Smiths, homemade caramel, and a Halloween lineup decorated by hand. Ghosts, mummies, skeletons and a bubbling Witch's Brew.

image.alt: The Halloween gourmet caramel apple lineup

seasons.title: Holidays at the shoppe
seasons.headline: Wrapped, ribboned and ready to give.
seasons.intro: Hand-decorated holiday apples, the best-selling Christmas Twist Stack and gift boxes for everyone on your list. If you need it by a date, tell us in the cart notes.

image.alt: Christmas pretzel twist stack tied with a bow

seasons.title: Valentine's Day
seasons.headline: Dipped to order, for someone sweet.
seasons.intro: Chocolate covered strawberry bouquets, a whole pound of Mountain Magic in a heart box, and a care package that ships.

seasons.title: Easter & Mother's Day
seasons.headline: Baskets, bunnies and berries for Mom.
seasons.intro: Ready-to-go Easter baskets, a hollow bunny full of jelly beans, and strawberries dipped in Mom's favorite color.

image.alt: Small Easter basket filled with Sweet Shoppe favorites

seasons.title: Graduation season
seasons.headline: Put your grad on a cookie.
seasons.intro: Custom photo Oreos for parties and gifts, plus strawberries and treats for the open house table.

image.alt: Chocolate covered Oreos printed with a graduate's photo

seasons.title: Summer favorites
seasons.headline: Caramel apples, all year long.
seasons.intro: Our apples aren't just for fall. Pick up a few, send a care package, or start the Club before the season rush.
